feedback: Second and final targeted repair: (1) Worker wrote portable repo references as file:///src/... and file:///docs/...; those links resolve to a machine root and will not work for project readers. Replace every such URI with a plain repository-relative path in backticks or a relative Markdown link. Keep source traceability. (2) New no-show row currently recommends exact states TRỄ_HẸN and HỦY_DO_VẮNG_MẶT and manager authority as if fixed; the user asked us to investigate this workflow, not approved those exact state names/policy. Label them as options to evaluate, mark policy unresolved, and avoid proposing automatic cancellation/release unless framed as a test/design question. (3) The user's absent-price concern is also an audit question: recommend fail-closed behavior for an unpriced item but label as proposed safe rule pending source/teacher/business review, not a confirmed adopted requirement. Preserve all historical/current distinctions and the limited conversation-access statement. Keep source grounded and concise.
reviewEvidence: Reviewed third proposal. Historical conversation limits, working tree caveats, added user scenarios, and relative paths are now correct. One remaining factual conflict persists in audit matrix row AUD-UI-01: it still claims F9 is unbound and recommends adding it, although current BanHangPOSPanel has VK_F9 registration and barcode handling. After two precise repair requests, Codex takes over this narrow correction and will preserve the rest of the proposal.
